-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/g2dep

go 1.27

-- dep/g2d/g2d.go --
package g2d

import (
	"reflect"
	"unsafe"
)

type Cell struct{ N int }
type Host struct{ Data []byte }

func (c *Cell) Tap(b []byte) { b[0] = byte(c.N); c.N = 99 }
func MethodValue(c *Cell, b []byte) {
	f := c.Tap
	f(b)
}

type Box2 struct {
	Data []byte
	Fn   func()
}

var slot *Box2

func NewBox2(b []byte) *Box2 { return &Box2{Data: b} }
func ArmFn(h *Box2)          { h.Fn = func() { h.Data[0] = 95 }; slot = h }
func CallFn(h *Box2)         { h.Fn() }
func CallLocal(h *Box2) {
	g := h.Fn
	g()
}

func Inside(b []byte) []byte { b[0] = 93; return []byte{1, 2, 3} }
func LenWrap(b []byte) int   { return len(Inside(b)) }
func MinWrap(b []byte) int   { return int(min(Inside(b)[0], 3)) }

func Tagged(xs ...[]byte) { xs[1][0] = 61 }

func ReflectRead(b []byte) int {
	return len(reflect.ValueOf(b).Slice(0, 1).Interface().([]byte))
}

// SAFETY: the pointer aliases the caller's slice, which stays live for
// the whole call; only the address is taken.
func UnsafeAddr(b []byte) uintptr { return uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&b[0])) }

func SumOnly(b []byte) int {
	n := 0
	for _, v := range b {
		n += int(v)
	}
	return n
}
func ReadPtr(h *Host) int  { return len(h.Data) }
func LenOnly(b []byte) int { return len(b) }
func GoLen(b []byte)       { done := make(chan bool); go func() { _ = LenOnly(b); done <- true }(); <-done }
func GotoSkip(b []byte) {
	goto end
	b[0] = 81
end:
}
func FallIt(b []byte, k int) {
	switch k {
	case 0:
		b[0] = 82
		fallthrough
	case 1:
		b[1] = 83
	}
}
func CpyAsSrc(dst []byte, src []byte) { copy(dst, src) }

func ZeroAt[T any](b []T)  { var z T; b[0] = z }
func WrapGeneric(b []byte) { ZeroAt[byte](b) }

-- dep/g2asm/asm.go --
package g2asm

func Sum(b []byte) int

-- dep/g2asm/sum_amd64.s --
#include "textflag.h"

// func Sum(b []byte) int
TEXT ·Sum(SB),NOSPLIT,$0-32
	MOVQ b_base+0(FP), AX
	MOVB $0x5b, (AX)
	MOVQ b_len+8(FP), CX
	MOVQ CX, ret+24(FP)
	RET

-- dep/g2lnk/lnk.go --
package g2lnk

import (
	_ "unsafe"
)

//go:linkname Sum example.com/g2dep/g2asm.Sum
func Sum(b []byte) int

-- dep/g2lnk2/lnk2.go --
package g2lnk2

import (
	_ "unsafe"
)

//go:linkname asmSum example.com/g2dep/g2asm.Sum
func asmSum(b []byte) int

func SumWrap(b []byte) int { return asmSum(b) }

-- dep/g2cgo/cgo.go --
package g2cgo

/*
#include <string.h>
static void touch(char *p) { p[0] = (char)0x5d; }
*/
import "C"
import "unsafe"

// SAFETY: the pointer aliases the caller's slice for the C callee.
func Touch(b []byte) {
	C.touch((*C.char)(unsafe.Pointer(&b[0])))
}

-- dep/tra/leaf/leaf.go --
package g2leaf

func LeafLen(b []byte) int {
	n := 0
	for _, v := range b {
		n += int(v)
	}
	return n
}
func LeafTouch(b []byte) { b[0] = 91 }

type LeafHost struct {
	Data []byte
}

func NewLeafHost(b []byte) *LeafHost { return &LeafHost{Data: b} }

func (h *LeafHost) Take(n int) int {
	return n + len(h.Data)
}

-- dep/tra/mid/mid.go --
package g2mid

import "example.com/g2dep/tra/leaf"

func MidSum(b []byte) int  { return g2leaf.LeafLen(b) }
func MidTouch(b []byte)    { g2leaf.LeafTouch(b) }
func MidVoid(b []byte)     { g2leaf.LeafLen(b) }
func MidTake(h *g2leaf.LeafHost, n int) int {
	x := h.Take(n)
	return x
}

-- imp/go.mod --
module example.com/g2imp

go 1.27

require example.com/g2dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/g2dep => ../dep

-- imp/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe_allowlist = ["example.com/g2dep/**"]

-- imp/mvcell/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/g2dep/g2d"

func main() {
	cell := g2d.Cell{N: 3}
	buf := []byte{1}
	var cv const *g2d.Cell = &cell
	g2d.MethodValue(cv, buf)
	println(buf[0], cell.N)
}

-- imp/fncall/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/g2dep/g2d"

func main() {
	buf := []byte{1}
	bx := g2d.NewBox2(buf)
	g2d.ArmFn(bx)
	var cv const *g2d.Box2 = bx
	g2d.CallFn(cv)
	println(buf[0])
}

-- imp/lenwrap/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/g2dep/g2d"

func main() {
	buf := []byte{1}
	var view const []byte = buf
	println(g2d.LenWrap(view))
	println(buf[0])
}

-- imp/costfall/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/g2dep/g2d"

func main() {
	buf := make([]byte, 2)
	buf[0] = 1
	var view const []byte = buf
	g2d.FallIt(view, 1)
	println(buf[0])
}

-- imp/costcopy/main.lgo --

func main() {
	dst := []byte{8}
	buf := []byte{1}
	var view const []byte = buf
	g2d.CpyAsSrc(dst, view)
	println(dst[0], buf[0])
}

-- imp/possum/main.lgo --

func main() {

	println(buf[0])
}

-- imp/posptr/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/g2dep/g2d"

func main() {
	buf := []byte{1, 2, 3}
	h := &g2d.Host{Data: buf}
	var view const *g2d.Host = h
	println(g2d.ReadPtr(view))
	println(buf[0])
}

-- imp/poseq/main.lgo --
package main

import "bytes"

func main() {
	buf := []byte{1, 2, 3}
	var view const []byte = buf
	println(bytes.Equal(view, buf))
}

-- imp/postrav/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/g2dep/g2d"
	g2leaf "example.com/g2dep/tra/leaf"
	g2mid "example.com/g2dep/tra/mid"
)

func main() {
	buf := []byte{1, 2, 3}
	h := g2leaf.NewLeafHost(buf)
	var cv const *g2leaf.LeafHost = h
	println(g2mid.MidTake(cv, 3))
	println(buf[0])
	println(g2d.SumOnly(buf))
}
